patches.reason: Android API 24 guards for WindowInsets and display cutouts; render-view accessor for surface-relative insets; Paseo-authored MakepadInputConnection implements a full Editable-backed IME, UTF-16 text/selection/composition snapshots, batch edits, surrounding-text queries, text/decimal/password editor metadata, hardware select/copy/cut/paste and native session/revision fencing. Modifier-only keys preserve composition; native acknowledgements cannot overwrite newer unpublished batch edits; hardware characters preserve the existing composing prefix. MakepadActivity and MakepadNative connect it to the matching vendored Rust platform, distinguishing editor restarts from same-editor synchronization and avoiding TYPE_NULL restarts between fields. Stationary long presses use current gesture coordinates and scrolling cancels the pending long press. The activity presents capability-limited floating ActionMode text actions, fences stale requests, tracks post-layout selection anchors and preserves UTF-16 clipboard text. MakepadInputConnection.java is new, not an upstream file.
